description: This file defines the Workbook class responsible for serializing a Spreadsheet object into the Office Open XML (XLSX) format. It handles creating XML structures for the workbook, including version info, properties, views, protection settings, sheets, and calculation parameters.

classes.name: Workbook
classes.description: Represents the Excel workbook structure and handles converting it into an XML format suitable for XLSX files.

methods.name: writeWorkbook
methods.description: Serializes a Spreadsheet object into XML, constructing the entire workbook structure including properties, sheets, and calculation settings.

methods.name: writeFileVersion
methods.description: Writes the file version details into the XML.

methods.name: writeWorkbookPr
methods.description: Writes the workbook properties, such as date system and code name.

methods.name: writeBookViews
methods.description: Writes the view settings of the workbook, such as active sheet, scrollbars, and visibility.

methods.name: writeWorkbookProtection
methods.description: Writes security and protection settings if enabled.

methods.name: writeCalcPr
methods.description: Writes calculation settings indicating whether formulas should be recalculated and related parameters.

methods.name: writeSheets
methods.description: Writes the sheet elements for each worksheet in the spreadsheet.

methods.name: writeSheet
methods.description: Writes individual sheet details including name, id, and state.
